lede: The biggest civic moment this week is in Norwood, where the Board of Trustees holds a public hearing Thursday on a resolution that could remove a sitting Planning Commission member — something that rarely happens in a small town and worth watching. Mountain Village Council also meets Thursday to vote on second reading of an ordinance changing how MVHA fees are set in the municipal code, alongside a resolution adopting the actual 2027 fee schedules. And over in Telluride, HARC takes up the Shandoka redevelopment at 860 Black Bear Rd on Tuesday, with public hearings on four new buildings across two agenda items — both continued since August.

notable.stake: Public hearing on formal removal of a sitting Planning Commission member.
Vote on MVHA fee ordinance and adoption of 2027 housing fee schedules.
Public hearings on four new buildings in the Town's own Shandoka redevelopment.
